- Added tests to cover:

Why this fixes the failing test

- The failing test expected "check http://example.io" to appear on a single line, even though that would exceed the width. The updated logic merges the URL with the preceding text when the URL length is <= width, producing "check http://example.io" on one line, which matches the test expectation.
- For URLs longer than the width, the code now flushes the current line and puts the URL on its own line, as required.
